description: This file defines a modules client for a dashboard frontend, providing functions to fetch module overviews and metrics from a backend API, including URL resolution, data fetching, and normalization.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL using environment variables, heuristics, or fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with optional credentials, handling organization ID and response parsing.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a dashboard modules overview, trying specific endpoints or deriving minimal data if unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated totals for the dashboard overview screen.
